title: CINCLANT Code Zebra alert over object off Newfoundland
place_text: Atlantic Command, Norfolk, Virginia; off Newfoundland

tellings.quote: he was uh working under Sync Atlantic Command, the commander-in-chief Atlantic Command in Norfolk and they went to a full code zebra alert,

plain: Sometime in the 1980s, the US military's Atlantic Command in Norfolk, Virginia, is said to have gone to a full Code Zebra alert, a top-level alarm, over an unknown object off Newfoundland. The UFO researcher Steven Greer tells it from a man named Merle Shane McDow, who he says was working under that command at the time, and he names Admiral Harry Train, its commander, in the story, which appears in a book called Disclosure: An Illustrated History. If true, it would mean a top naval command treated an unexplained object as a real threat.
